title: Z9.F — Actual five-output matrix is nonsingular for even n≥2
milestone_description: For every even natural number n≥2, the matrix whose monomial rows are the actual constant/rho3/rho5/rho7/rho9 coefficient outputs has nonzero determinant. This is the actual rational-function coefficient matrix, with the specified row convention; it does not assert the result for odd n or n=0.
